everything in view that uses it has the new model now (the world around you was reloaded)
the land around you was read again (as after a teleport); tiles further away read the new file when you get there
2 rows updated in place: the game uses them the next time it looks a row up (an open window or a cached tooltip may show the old text until it is opened again)

interface files are read when the interface loads: type /reload in the chat (or relog)
